high_level_description: This image is a tweet from Barack Obama's official Twitter account (@BarackObama). The tweet is a tribute to Raila Odinga, describing him as a true champion of democracy. The text highlights Odinga's dedication to the cause of freedom and self-governance in Kenya, noting his willingness to put the interests of his country ahead of personal ambitions. Obama mentions observing Odinga's commitment to peaceful reconciliation and core values throughout his life. The tweet concludes with an expression of condolences to Odinga's family and the people of Kenya.
